dataset: DisputePilot v2.0 — Final Canonical Cases (data-preparation deliverable)
generated_by: Data preparation workstream (parallel to the S8 automation workstream; no code modified)

join_keys.scenario_id: matches s7_scenario_registry.json scenarios[].scenario_id (O4/O5 historical entries excepted)
join_keys.amount: unique per case across the batch (see s8 operations guide)

rules: External complaint texts (Twitter threads, Olist records) are language/business-context references ONLY. They are not PayPal dispute records and are never claimed to be.

All case content (item names, complaint texts, evidence conditions, drafts) in this dataset is SCENARIO_DEFINED (authored during data preparation) unless marked PAYPAL_API_OBSERVED or HUMAN_OBSERVED_SANDBOX_UI.
Expected evidence requirements and candidate seller actions are OFFLINE evaluation expectations; they are NOT real-time PayPal API observations until confirmed at runtime.
No real personal identity information is copied into the scenarios; excerpts are redacted/paraphrased.
Simulated fulfillment materials are notes-only and explicitly labeled; fabricated logistics documents, receipts, or adjudication claims are prohibited.
Negative samples carry 'source_review_status' (the AI-review pipeline status of the source text, e.g. NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW). It is NOT a five-layer provenance label and must not be read as one.
